bug_description.original: Crash Type: Use-of-uninitialized-value; Crash State: parse_sigalgs_list / SSL_CTX_set1_sigalgs_list / ssl_ctx_api.cc::$_45::operator; Sanitizer: memory (MSAN)
bug_description.normalized: In parse_sigalgs_list, the stack buffer 'buf' is declared without initialization. When attacker-controlled input provides a short token (fewer characters than the target comparison string) followed by a '+' delimiter, the buffer is only partially filled and null-terminated. The compiler optimizes the subsequent strcmp(buf, "ECDSA") into a fixed-size memcmp of 6 bytes, causing a read of uninitialized stack memory beyond the null-terminated portion of buf.

source.description: Attacker-controlled signature algorithm string is first consumed to compute string length and element count.
source.value_from: Fuzz input parsed by GetString in LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput and passed through SSL_CTX_set1_sigalgs_list as the str parameter.
source.note: Attacker-controlled string is first consumed to compute len, which determines the loop bounds for processing characters into the uninitialized stack buffer.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

sink.description: Use of uninitialized stack bytes when compiler-optimized strcmp reads a fixed 6-byte region from partially-initialized buf.
sink.note: strcmp is compiler-optimized to memcmp(buf, "ECDSA", 6), reading 6 bytes from buf unconditionally. When buf_used < 5, bytes beyond the null terminator are uninitialized stack memory. MSAN detects uninitialized bytes at offset 2 within the 6-byte read region.

root_cause.description: Stack buffer declared without zero-initialization, leaving bytes beyond those explicitly written indeterminate.
root_cause.note: Stack buffer of 23 bytes declared without initialization. Only characters explicitly written via buf[buf_used++] and the null terminator buf[buf_used]=0 become initialized; remaining bytes retain indeterminate stack content.

tainted_value_origin.note: Fuzz input is parsed into a length-prefixed string by GetString and passed to SSL_CTX_set1_sigalgs_list.

fine_trace.code: for (const char *p = str; *p; p++) { len++; if (*p == ':') { num_elements++; } }
fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled string str is consumed to compute len (string length) and num_elements (colon count + 1). For the PoC input, len is a small value determining loop bounds.
23-byte stack buffer allocated without initialization. All bytes are indeterminate. Only explicit writes (character accumulation and null termination) will make specific bytes defined.

Characters from the input string that pass the alphanumeric/dash/underscore check are written into buf one at a time. For the PoC, only a small number of characters are accumulated before the '+' delimiter is encountered, leaving buf mostly uninitialized.
On encountering '+', the buffer is null-terminated at position buf_used. Bytes buf[0..buf_used] are initialized (characters plus null), but buf[buf_used+1..22] remain uninitialized.

Guard only checks that buf_used is non-zero (at least one character written). No check that buf_used >= strlen("ECDSA")=5, so any token shorter than 5 characters proceeds to strcmp with partially uninitialized buf.

strcmp is compiler-optimized to memcmp(buf, "ECDSA", 6), unconditionally reading 6 bytes from buf. When buf_used < 5, bytes beyond the null terminator at buf[buf_used] are uninitialized. MSAN detects uninitialized bytes at offset 2 in the 6-byte comparison region.

poc.trigger: The 5-byte PoC encodes: byte[0]=0x5b selects the SSL_CTX_set1_sigalgs_list API via kAPIs[91%46=45]; byte[1]=0x03 is a u8 length prefix for GetString; bytes[2..4]={0x5f,0x2b,0x20} form the string passed to parse_sigalgs_list. The short token before '+' results in only partial initialization of the stack buffer buf before strcmp compares it against longer constant strings.

format.name: libfuzzer-ssl-ctx-api
format.contract: A binary blob where byte 0 selects an SSL_CTX API function and subsequent bytes provide a u8-length-prefixed string argument. The string must contain a short alphabetic/underscore token followed by '+' to trigger the strcmp comparison path in parse_sigalgs_list with a partially-uninitialized stack buffer.
